verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a public API: there is a developer API documentation page and an API tokens help article. The JMAP protocol behind it is fully documented, covering session discovery via /.well-known/jmap, OAuth/Bearer auth, batched methodCalls for query, fetch and send, and EventSource/WebPush push. The missing OpenAPI and llms.txt probes do not contradict this, since JMAP is its own documented standard. Missing for 10: Fastmail-specific API doc content is evidenced only by page titles rather than detail, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Fastmail through the API.
